article.headline: Matt Rogers scores 20 to lead American University over Army 71-68, extending win streak to 7
article.description: — Matt Rogers had 20 points to help American University hold off Army 71-68 on Saturday for the Eagles' seventh victory in a row.
article.linkText: Matt Rogers scores 20 to lead American University over Army 71-68, extending win streak to 7
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Matt Rogers had 20 points to help American University hold off Army 71-68 on Saturday for the Eagles' seventh victory in a row. Rogers added eight rebounds for the Eagles (14-9, 8-2 Patriot League). Elijah Stephens totaled 14 points and six rebounds. Colin Smalls scored 11. Ryan Curry led the Black Knights (12-10, 6-4) with 19 points, eight rebounds and four steals. Jalen Rucker added 15 points. Josh Scovens pitched in with 12 points and nine rebounds. American went into halftime leading Army 31-27. Stephens scored 10 points in the half. Rogers' 15-point second half helped American close out the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
